Privacy Policy

How Replaice handles information provided through this website.

Who we are

Replaice Technologies Pvt Ltd operates this website. For privacy questions or requests, email contactus@replaice.co.

Information we collect

When you contact us, we collect the details you provide, including your name, business email, company, country, product interest, and message. Our hosting provider processes your IP address and may derive an approximate city, region, and country. We include the approximate location, when available, in the internal enquiry notification.

How we use information

We use your information to respond to your enquiry, send a confirmation, route the enquiry to the relevant team, and protect the website from abuse. Please avoid including confidential information or sensitive personal data in your message.

Who receives information

Authorized Replaice team members, our hosting provider, and our email delivery providers process enquiry information for these purposes. Processing may take place outside your country.

Retention and your choices

We keep enquiry information for as long as needed to respond, follow up, and meet applicable obligations. Depending on applicable law, you may request access, correction, or deletion, or raise a concern about how we handle your information by contacting us.

Other websites

Links to external products or services are subject to their own privacy policies.
